fields.summary: TC-785-01: Event Store Records COA Events Correctly After Stream App Changes

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-785

Precondition: Event store changes have been deployed. A valid COA event (pairing/assignment/aggregated) is generated and processed. The event store must capture and persist the event with correct data and sequencing.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Trigger a CSS pairing and assignment event that flows through the COA pipeline
Valid CSS event: new trip assignment published to Kafka pairing and assignment topics
Pairing and assignment events are published to Kafka topics and processed by the stream app
Verify the event store captures the pairing event with correct trip and DP data
Event store entries after pairing event processing
Event store contains the pairing event record with tripId, dpNumber, legs, and timestamps correctly stored
Verify the event store captures the assignment event with correct crew member and assignment data
Event store entries after assignment event processing
Event store contains the assignment event with cmidnumber, tripId, assignmentId, and version correctly stored
Verify event sequencing is preserved - events are stored in order of occurrence
Multiple events generated for same trip: V0 then V1. Event store should reflect V0 before V1
Event store shows V0 event recorded before V1 event - sequence order is preserved
Verify no duplicate events are stored in the event store for a single CSS event publication
Event store query for the tripId after a single CSS event
Exactly one event record per CSS publication - no duplicates stored in the event store
